related.description: GUI library for displaying various popups (HUD), written in pure Swift.
A clean and lightweight progress HUD for your iOS and tvOS app.
A clean and lightweight progress HUD based on SVProgressHUD, converted to Swift with the help of Swiftify.
ProgressHUD is a lightweight and easy-to-use HUD for iOS. Over 5000+ animations.
Replacement for MacOS' volume, brightness and keyboard backlight HUDs.
